Evidence / CLM-006
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?September 2022

Finance severity within a specific denominator

01What does this evidence establish?

Among the formal firms in the report's finance-obstacle tabulation, which excludes firms that said they did not need a loan, the shares rating finance as a major or a moderate obstacle together total 91.84%.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The combined share of formal firms rating access to finance as a major or moderate obstacle, among firms in the survey report's finance-obstacle tabulation (firms that said they did not need a loan are excluded), seven governorates, 2022.

03Who or what does it apply to?

Formal enterprises in seven selected governorates

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to the 2022 survey (September 2022). It should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable observation is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

The combined 91.84% is not the share of all Yemeni firms that face a major or moderate finance obstacle; it applies only to the firms in the report's filtered tabulation.

Limits of the measure

The survey is not national, and the finance-obstacle table uses a filtered base whose number of firms is not recorded in the evidence base; some other tables rest on small conditional bases.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Two shares reported by the source for the 2022 World Bank custom enterprise survey (September 2022), in Yemen Financial Sector Diagnostics (2024), Annex III, Figure 107 ('Degree by Which Access to Finance is an Obstacle'), p. 145; the source's tabulation excludes firms that said they did not need a loan. The combined 91.84% is computed by this resource as the sum of the two shares: major obstacle 68.71% plus moderate obstacle 23.13%.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
